title: Core Platform Architecture
description: Interactive system cartography for a 3-tier web application

systems.name: Frontend Web Client
systems.summary: Single Page Application delivering the user dashboard, authentication flows, and real-time event subscriptions.

internal.title: Frontend Application Atlas
internal.description: Client-side page routing hierarchy, global state stores, and networking clients.

nodes.name: AppLayout & Shell
nodes.summary: Global navigation sidebar, topbar user menu, theme switcher, and toast notifications provider.

details.invariants: Renders unauthenticated banner when offline; intercepts global window errors.

nodes.name: /login & /signup
nodes.summary: Credentials input, passwordless magic links, and OAuth redirect callback handlers.

details.invariants: Rate-limited client-side after 5 invalid attempts with exponential backoff.

nodes.name: /dashboard
nodes.summary: Real-time metrics widgets, tenant usage charts, and recent activity audit logs.

details.invariants: Requires active session token; renders skeleton loader during query hydration.

nodes.name: /settings/billing
nodes.summary: Stripe subscription portal, seat allocation, invoice history downloads, and payment methods.

details.invariants: Restricted to users with role >= ORG_ADMIN.

nodes.name: Auth & Session Store
nodes.summary: In-memory reactive token store, silent refresh scheduler, and user permission claims evaluator.

details.invariants: Access token strictly in memory; refresh token secured via HttpOnly cookie.

nodes.name: API Gateway Client
nodes.summary: Axios/Fetch wrapper with automatic Bearer token injection, retry on 503, and 401 refresh interception.

details.invariants: Generates unique X-Request-ID trace header per outbound invocation.

systems.name: Core Application Service
systems.summary: Primary application service hosting business logic, REST APIs, permission enforcement, and transaction orchestration.

internal.title: Backend Service Topology
internal.description: Internal bounded contexts, routers, middleware, and database access abstraction layers.

nodes.name: Security & Trace Middleware
nodes.summary: CORS pre-flight, rate-limiting (sliding window redis), distributed trace context extraction.

details.invariants: Drops any request payload larger than 5MB with HTTP 413.

nodes.name: Identity & Auth Domain
nodes.summary: Handles login, password hashing, multi-factor verification tokens, and session revocation list.

details.invariants: Passwords hashed with Argon2id minimum memory cost 64MB.

nodes.name: Billing & Subscription Domain
nodes.summary: Manages tier entitlements, customer metered billing, webhook idempotent ingestion, and invoice states.

details.invariants: Webhook events deduplicated via idempotent lock before processing.

nodes.name: ORM & Repository Layer
nodes.summary: Async Unit of Work repository abstractions providing transactional atomicity and connection pooling.

details.invariants: All write transactions execute under READ COMMITTED isolation.

systems.name: Primary Datastore
systems.summary: ACID transactional relational database storing tenant accounts, users, entitlements, and event ledgers.

internal.title: Relational Schema Topology
internal.description: Primary tables, relationship constraints, and index groupings.

nodes.name: users & auth_tokens
nodes.summary: User profile records, hashed credentials, MFA secret seeds, status enum (ACTIVE, SUSPENDED).

nodes.name: tenants & organizations
nodes.summary: Organization boundaries, plan limits, workspace configurations, and billing customer references.

nodes.name: subscription_events
nodes.summary: Immutable log of invoice creations, plan downgrades, credit usage ticks, and audit events.

connectors.name: Client-to-Service REST Bridge
connectors.summary: Synchronous request/response pipeline handling all client interactions, data queries, and command mutations.

endpoints.desc: Authenticates credentials and sets HTTP-only refresh cookie
Rotates refresh token and returns fresh access token
Aggregates tenant metrics and recent activity feeds
Creates Stripe checkout session for plan upgrade

connectors.name: Postgres Connection Pool
connectors.summary: Persistent async connection pool running via asyncpg/SQLAlchemy with automated connection health probes.

endpoints.desc: Row-Level Security (RLS) enforcement set per transaction: SET LOCAL app.current_tenant_id = $1
Strict linear schema migration table tracking active schema revision hash
